# Flipclock

A flip clock webapp for a phone mounted in a holder on a desk: looked at, never
operated. Two faces in a swipe carousel: the clock and a focus timer on the
same plates. SvelteKit 2, Svelte 5 in forced runes mode, TypeScript, Tailwind
v4, shadcn-svelte, Node 24 LTS. Local first: no backend, no API, no tracking,
no CDN, and no network at all after the first load. At rest the screen shows only
the clock on black. A tap toggles fullscreen, a swipe up from anywhere or a
long press of about 600 ms opens
a settings overlay that dismisses itself. There is no visible control.

## Source files

- src/routes/+page.svelte: the stage. Holds the tick, the wake lock, the OLED
  pixel shift, the theme attribute, the pointer gestures and the one time hint,
  and hands each face to the carousel as a snippet.
- src/lib/components/FaceCarousel.svelte: embla over an array of faces, bound to
  the current one. Owns the two way sync between scroll position and settings.
- src/lib/components/ClockFace.svelte: the clock. Plates, the optional half size
  seconds, the subline (date or own words) and the spoken time.
- src/lib/components/FocusFace.svelte: the focus timer. Drift free countdown on
  the same plates, tap starts and pauses (wired by the page), progress hairline,
  vibration at zero. Duration comes from the settings presets.
- src/lib/components/FlipCard.svelte: one two digit card, four layers, CSS
  keyframes, and the flip duration it hands to the CSS as --flip-ms. Honors
  prefers-reduced-motion by jumping instead of flipping.
- src/lib/components/SettingsOverlay.svelte: the long press overlay.
  shadcn-svelte controls in a bespoke container: focus trap, Escape, idle auto
  dismiss, bottom sheet on phones, centered panel on wide screens, two columns
  when short.
- src/routes/+layout.svelte: shell. Imports app.css, links icon and manifest.
- src/routes/+layout.ts: prerender = true and ssr = false, so the build is a
  static shell despite adapter-node.
- src/lib/clock.ts: time reading, formatting, and the drift free tick that
  recomputes the delay to the next boundary from Date on every step.
- src/lib/gestures.ts: long press and swipe up on one pointer, coordinates in
  and callbacks out, so it runs without a DOM and has its own tests.
- src/lib/settings.svelte.ts: localStorage persistence, versioned migration
  chain, and the settings singleton. Reads go through one derived, writes are
  buffered and reach storage as a batch or when the page hides.
- src/lib/wakelock.svelte.ts: screen wake lock, re taken whenever the document
  becomes visible again.
- src/lib/components/ui/, src/lib/utils.ts, src/routes/layout.css,
  components.json: the shadcn-svelte layer.
- src/service-worker.ts: caches [...build, ...files] plus the prerendered shell.
  Cache first for assets, network with cache fallback otherwise. No skipWaiting.
- src/app.css: size token inputs, theme presets via [data-theme], the shared
  plate row, aspect ratio media queries, sr-only, the digit @font-face.
- static/digits.woff2: Roboto at 600, digits only, 1.5 KB, equal advances.
- src/lib/*.test.ts: vitest, pure logic only (clock, gestures, settings).
- e2e/clock.spec.ts: playwright against the production build. Faces, gestures,
  settings, persistence, offline.

## Settings

localStorage key: flip-clock-settings. One JSON object with a version integer.
Keys: use24h (boolean), showSeconds (boolean), subline ('off' | 'date' |
'text'), sublineText (string, max 60), face ('clock' | 'focus'), focusMinutes
(number, 1 to 180), theme ('default' | 'warm' | 'night' | 'slate'),
brightness (number, 0.2 to 1).
The list is closed. No timers, alarms, weather, calendar, music, accounts, sync
or color pickers.

The object also carries hintSeen (boolean), which is not a setting and is not in
the overlay. It records whether the one time "hold to customise" line has been
shown, so a first run points at the long press once and never again.
